title: Where the slow window pages go: ulpin-reh-02 at 7a6fded0, timed through the product's routes
why: Two Niagara window pages took 31.2 s and 34.8 s in REH6; the judges watch this map on 22 October.
stopRule: Same runner failing twice, a page not 200 twice in a row, or the demo doctor changing: stop and report.
successCriterion: One page over 10 s reproduced with 80% or more of its seconds attributed to one named part (browser queue,
pool wait, API CPU, database), or every page under 3 s across direct and Studio runs (not reproduced).

title: A sealed set of public files nobody on the team has chosen, for the dress rehearsal
why: The demo ingests the judges' unknown files; every public file we hold was chosen and looked at by us.
stopRule: After 90 minutes of search keep what passes; a fetch failing twice is not retried a third time.
successCriterion: 4 to 6 kept files in three or more formats from new issuing authorities, each with an open licence, a receipt
and no personal data, at least one map layer; sealed manifest of path, bytes, SHA-256, format, licence only.

title: Dress rehearsal on ulpin-reh-02: NYC data, then the sealed set, through the Studio to a property card
why: No run has yet gone the whole way through the Studio from a dropped file to a card, as on 22 October.
stopRule: The same step failing twice moves to the next file; the demo doctor changing stops everything.
successCriterion: Both acts run to a card or to a recorded break, with per-file timings, frame figures (largest frame, frames
over 100 ms) and every officer action recorded.

title: Building model: B9's three regions without scale augmentation, one preregistered DEV comparison
why: B9 is 350 roofs short of DEV recall 0.70 and lost small roofs; its two changes were never separated.
stopRule: Non-finite loss, seconds per chip above 0.3 after 200 steps, GPU memory above 7 GiB, a rehearsal container
running, or the same failure twice: stop; no relaunch without the lead.
successCriterion: Committed preregistration before the smoke, one run, and a DEV result by the preregistered rule (pass_dev,
beats_b9 or rejected) with size-bin recall against B3 epoch 4 and B9 epoch 3; no holdout call.

title: Teacher round: header variants of the verified positive columns (fallback learner Step 1, labels only)
why: The learner panel's student has 33 positives and no correct positive commit; T-data fired (A4e).
stopRule: A seed count other than 33 (32 without the footprint), or the self-check failing twice after a repair.
successCriterion: At most 640 variant lines over 32 seeds, header text only, passing the self-check.

title: Learner work: filter the variants, one Stage A retrain with them, counts only
why: Step 1 counts only if the student then commits a correct positive field with no wrong one.
stopRule: The option-off reproduction of A4e differs, a services/** change would be needed, or a failure twice.
successCriterion: A measured result by the A4e arm: supported only with at least one correct positive commit and zero wrong
commits in pooled leave-one-family-out; otherwise a recorded miss and no further attempt.
